description.p: This is a community package of Drosophila, maintained independently and published with the permission of its developer. It repackages the official upstream Linux release unmodified and follows upstream releases automatically.
Drosophila is a desktop application for running, configuring and monitoring an embedded Yggdrasil-ng node, written in Rust with GTK 4 and libadwaita.

ul.li: Run and monitor an embedded Yggdrasil-ng node.
Manage peers and the private key.
See the node's IPv6 address, subnet and peer status.
Connect through a TUN interface or a local HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy.

description.p: Permissions: TUN mode starts Drosophila's own binary on the host through flatpak-spawn and PolicyKit (pkexec), limited to CAP_NET_ADMIN, so the host needs pkexec and a PolicyKit agent. The flatpak-spawn permission allows the app to run any host command.
The System Proxy mode does not change the host's proxy settings in this package: the sandbox has no access to the desktop's dconf settings. Use TUN or Proxy mode instead.
